name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a **bold, full-width focus ring** that appears immediately on keyboard focus. This ensures keyboard users see where they are without relying on color alone, fixing contrast and visibility issues. The trade-off is visual clutter for mouse users, but we mitigate this by making the ring subtle (low opacity) and only visible during keyboard navigation. This meets WCAG 2.2’s focus visibility requirement while keeping the interface clean for others.

name: Reader
text: A bold, full-width focus ring risks creating a "siren effect" for keyboard users with cognitive or vestibular sensitivities, especially in reduced-motion contexts. Instead, use a **single-pixel, high-contrast ring** that’s subtle but unmistakable—settle the argument with user testing: measure task completion time and error rates for keyboard nav in both high-contrast and reduced-motion modes.
